correctness.rationale: Full construction and quantifiers were reconstructed. The ratio A/B is explicitly R(u)e^{2πiv} on 1/2<u<1, with R monotone 0→∞. The polynomial identity eliminates all B=0 potential zeros and proves exactly d! permutation roots. The symmetric coefficient map has Vandermonde nonzero determinant at distinct roots and positive quotient Jacobians, yielding the stated identical strictly positive determinant. Tensor products give compact support. The universal transverse count is the known Euler top Chern number d!, with explicit orientation. Finite d=1..5 program checks are supporting only.

value.rationale: The precise topological defect count in a critical multivariate Gabor/Zak problem is a natural invariant of the preceding N≤d obstruction. Its sharp attainability by explicit compactly supported windows and all-positive transverse zeros is a substantive constructive classification rather than an arbitrary fixed-parameter calculation: one may prescribe any distinct slit-plane root data, locate every zero, and compute its local Jacobian. It distinguishes generic simple defects from potentially high-index degenerate ones, and quantifies a natural boundary of d-window frame failure. The previously known factorial Euler count alone is not claimed as valuable new content.
